nom: Cetaphil Extra Gentle Daily Scrub Exfoliating Face Wash

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the scrub reduces excess shine and unclogs pores, though one says she needs to double-cleanse afterward to remove all the dirt because it feels so gentle.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some managing eczema or psoriasis, mostly report softer skin and reduced flaking without over-drying, though one found it too drying in winter.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it cleans thoroughly without stripping moisture and is gentle enough for daily use.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive, reactive, or rosacea-prone skin report no irritation, redness or breakouts and several call it the first scrub that works for them, but a minority describe severe reactions including burning, allergic swelling, or a red rash covering the face.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the scrub cleans without stripping or tightening skin and several describe it as hydrating even on dry skin; a few found it too drying, particularly in winter or as part of a bad reaction that also involved dryness and patchiness.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with rosacea, report no redness or irritation from daily use; a minority describe burning on application, and one reports a red rash covering her face that would not calm down.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers say the scrub helps maintain the skin's natural barrier, leaving skin smooth and balanced rather than tight or stripped.
concerns.spots: One reviewer noted it evened her teenager's skin tone alongside clearer pores; this is a thin, isolated mention rather than a widely reported effect.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some describing chronic or acne-prone skin, report clearer pores, fewer blackheads and controlled breakouts; one reviewer's skin broke out further alongside a burning reaction and a rash.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced shine and skin better prepped for other products, though one needs to double-cleanse to fully remove oil and makeup.

aspects.libelle: Too mild to feel like real exfoliation for some
Scent can feel strong to some users
Rinses off cleanly with no residue

extraits.texte: I started using this product about a month ago and it had caused so many problems with my skin! The first time I used it, it started burning my skin I couldn't get it off fast enough! I tried using it several more times after to give it more of a chance and every time it got worse. I was breaking out and experiencing a lot of dryness and patchiness. However after using it this last time I am throwing this product out. I now have a horrible red rash all over my face on top of the acne and dry patches! Nothing I do is calming it down or making it go away! Everything that I try just makes my skin burn! I am so disappointed in this product especially since it is made by Cetaphil! I have never had such a bad reaction to ANY face products the way I have with this. I will not be recommending this product to anyone! Cetaphil really needs to re evaluate this product being as tho there are SO MANY bad reviews on this product claiming the same experience I am having!!!

extraits.titre: Must have for my skincare daily routine
extraits.texte: I've been using Cetaphil Extra Gentle Daily Scrub for over two years now, and as a woman with oily skin, it's become my go-to for daily cleansing without any drama. The microfine buffing particles gently exfoliate away dullness and excess oil, leaving my skin feeling incredibly soft and smooth, almost velvety, especially after long days when my T-zone gets shiny. Unlike harsher scrubs that used to irritate or dry me out, this one nourishes with vitamins B5 and E, helping maintain my skin's barrier so I rarely deal with redness or tightness, even during hormonal fluctuations. Over time, I've noticed fewer clogged pores and blackheads, making my complexion more even and radiant without needing stronger actives. The subtle, fresh scent is a bonus—it's not overpowering and fades quickly, which is perfect for my sensitive nose. While it's gentle enough for every morning use, I pair it with a light moisturizer to lock in that post-scrub glow. Overall, it's reliable, affordable, and has kept my routine simple and effective through my 30s.

extraits.titre: First cleanser that works on my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I have struggled with a skin condition for years. I cannot tell you the number of products I have tried with no success. This scrub keeps my pores clear with no irritation or breakouts. I do use a very light weight, waterbased gel mortise after using it. I have had outbreaks and peeling caused by demodex bemy in t-zone. I also have rosacea. Alright my skin flecks slightly dry, I cannot use any cream based products - even if they are oil free. This product is helping my skin to clear and heal. So thankful for it. I use it twice a day.

extraits.titre: Leaves my skin looking and feeling soft!
extraits.texte: I have naturally very dry skin and this has really helped minimize any skin flaking. It's not abrasive like other products i've tried and leaves my skin feeling super soft!

I have combination skin and this cleanser is gentle enough to use every day. I like the light texture and its fine granules. It's more of a cleanser, however it gives that extra bit of oomf to get my skin clean without drying it out. It leaves my skin feeling clean without a residue.

extraits.titre: Gentle exfoliating cleanser without over-drying yo
extraits.texte: Cetaphil extra gentle daily scrub is a mild yet effective exfoliate that works well for sensitive skin. The clear formula contains fine particles that exfoliate without irritating or stripping moisture. After each use, my skin feels noticeably softer smoother and refreshed. It removes dead skin gently while maintaining the skin natural barrier. I like it because it does not cause redness or dryness. The cleanser leaves my face, clean, comfortable and healthy.
